statement: culture/race/race.ath: every 2x2 table of nonnegative integers with total N <= 12 (1820 tables): 819 margin classes, 506 with more than one table, the largest has 7 (margins 6 and 6, N = 12); the Frechet bounds max(0, r + c - N) <= a <= min(r, c) are exact in every class. Du Bois's one-way gaze reuses asymmetry.py (non-symmetric preorders map onto the 2-chain). Readings are analogy.
